description: This Java class defines the entity 'SmsCampaign', representing an SMS campaign in the system. It includes campaign properties such as name, type, trigger, status, messages, scheduling details, and lifecycle methods like activate, close, reactivate, and delete. It also manages campaign state validation and recurrence scheduling.

classes.name: SmsCampaign
classes.description: Entity class representing an SMS campaign with properties, lifecycle methods, validation, and recurrence scheduling capabilities.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new SmsCampaign instance from a JsonCommand, submitting user, and report, parsing parameters including campaign details, trigger type, recurrence, and notification status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the campaign's properties based on provided JsonCommand, tracking changes for persistence.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the campaign, setting status to active, approval date, and approver, with validation to prevent re-activation.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the campaign, sets closure date, last/next trigger dates, and updates status with validation to prevent multiple closures.

methods.name: reactivate
methods.description: Reactivates a closed campaign, resetting approval and closure details, and changing status to active.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks the campaign as not visible, effectively deleting it after validation that it is in a closed state.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns true if the campaign status is active.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Returns true if the campaign status is pending.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns true if the campaign status is closed.

methods.name: isDirect
methods.description: Returns true if the trigger type is direct.

methods.name: isSchedule
methods.description: Returns true if the trigger type is scheduled.

methods.name: isTriggered
methods.description: Returns true if the trigger type is triggered.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks when activating or updating campaigns.

methods.name: validateReactivate
methods.description: Performs validation checks when reactivating a campaign.

methods.name: validateClosureDate
methods.description: Validates that the closure date is not in the future.

methods.name: validateActivationDate
methods.description: Validates submitted, activation, and future date constraints during activation.

methods.name: constructRecurrence
methods.description: Constructs recurrence string based on frequency, interval, and days from JsonCommand input.

methods.name: constructRecurrence
methods.description: Builds recurrence string from CalendarFrequencyType, interval, and repeat days.
